summary: First sourced pass on a pending-duty/authority question in the captured dragonboat snapshot. Registered one investigation (ReadIndex requests outstanding when a leader loses authority), five sourced knowledge entries, and a source-only explained interpretation with no defect claim yet. Sources show the raft layer discards registered read contexts on reset() without a dropped notification, that a deposed leader cannot confirm them from stale heartbeat responses, and that the node layer terminates never-indexed batches as RequestTimeout from the caller deadline driven by LocalTick event iterations. No execution was run; the same-batch confirmation-versus-reset race remains an open discriminator and registered gap, along with deeper reading of snapshot/recovery and configuration paths.
